description: Use for exchange rates, customs exchange rates (customs=true), the most expensive currencies (ranking=true) and the gold price. Use fineness=true for the price of 1 g of gold 585, 750 or other fineness and for the gold ounce price in USD. NBP mid, bid and ask rates of currencies against PLN (table), the history of one currency (table A daily, table B weekly, e.g. RUB, AED), the NBP gold price (code "XAU"), the gold price by fineness and the troy ounce in USD (fineness=true), customs exchange rates (customs=true): NBP table A rate of the penultimate Wednesday of a month, used for customs value in the next month, or the ranking of the most expensive currencies (ranking=true): NBP tables A and B of the same day, place 52 weeks earlier.

code.description: ISO code, e.g. EUR, USD, CHF, RUB; "XAU" for gold. Omit for the main currencies.

customs.description: true: customs exchange rates of the current and next month. With code: one currency.

days.description: History window in days for one currency, default 90.

fineness.description: true: price of 1 g of gold of each fineness legal in Poland (999, 960, 750, 585, 500, 375, 333) with karats, and the price of a troy ounce in USD, now and a year ago. Code is XAU or omitted.

ranking.description: true: most expensive currencies against PLN from NBP tables A and B. With code: the place of one currency.

name: get_currency_rates
title: NBP exchange rates and gold
